roles.name: Accounting
roles.description: Books the transactions; reads operations, does not change them

roles.name: Back Support / Admin
roles.description: Checks a sales order and a budget request after the team leader; prepares purchase orders

roles.name: CEO / President
roles.description: The Chief Executive Officer / President — prepares quotations needing no approval, and is the CEO step on the quotation and sales order routes

roles.name: Cost Controller
roles.description: Checks the cost and margin of a sales order — the third signature on the sales order route

roles.name: Designer Support
roles.description: Draws what the CAD job orders ask for: takes a request, reports progress, submits revisions

roles.name: Designer Lead
roles.description: Runs the design team’s queue: assigns CAD job orders, sets priority, submits and closes drawings

roles.name: Employee
roles.description: Clocks in, files leave and overtime, sees their own records

roles.name: Executive / Management
roles.description: Sees everything across the business, approves at the top band, changes nothing operationally

roles.name: Finance
roles.description: Receivables, payables, expenses and cash — approves disbursements

roles.name: Finance Manager
roles.description: Approves budget requests after the team leader and back support; the CEO / President follows above ₱100,000

roles.name: HR
roles.description: Employees, attendance, leave and overtime — the second approval on overtime

roles.name: Industry Specialist
roles.description: Prepares quotations, sales orders, purchase requisitions and budget requests — the team leader approves first

roles.name: Procurement
roles.description: Canvasses suppliers and issues purchase orders — does not receive and does not pay

roles.name: Project Engineer
roles.description: Executes the work: progress reports, purchase requests, requests for approval — and costs the work (the costing route starts with an engineer)

roles.name: Project Manager
roles.description: Runs projects — budget, procurement requests, progress and billing. Technical Managers now hold the same rights; this role is kept for those who already have it

roles.name: Purchasing Manager
roles.description: Approves every purchase order — the first signature; the CEO / President follows above ₱100,000

roles.name: Sales
roles.description: Works own leads and quotations; sees the shared customer master

roles.name: Sales Manager
roles.description: Everything Sales can do, plus approval of quotations and visibility over the whole pipeline

roles.name: Service Engineer
roles.description: After-market: commissioning, preventive maintenance and inspection reports

roles.name: Service Manager
roles.description: Owns service contracts, the PM schedule and renewals; approves service reports

roles.name: Supervisor
roles.description: Approves leave and overtime for their direct reports

roles.name: Team Leader
roles.description: Leads a sales team — approves its quotations, sales orders, costings, purchase requisitions and budget requests

roles.name: Technical Manager
roles.description: Manages projects (the project manager is the Technical Manager) and is the first signature on costings, requisitions, job orders and supplier bills

roles.name: Trainer
roles.description: Schedules and runs Gruntech Academy sessions, records attendance and results

roles.name: Warehouse
roles.description: Receives goods, issues stock, manages borrow slips — does not issue POs

roles.name: Warehouse Supervisor
roles.description: Approves incoming and outgoing for warehouse staff who report to nobody else; runs the warehouse
